title: Yellowish Gooey Japanese Rice Ochazuke
description: A satvik-friendly, meal-prep Japanese dish featuring self-raising flour and a gooey texture, served in a talavera plate. This ochazuke recipe combines grassy and savory flavors for a unique taste experience.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the self-raising flour and water until smooth.
Heat the sesame oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced scallions and shiitake mushrooms to the skillet and saute until tender.
Add the cooked Japanese short grain rice to the skillet and stir to combine with the scallion and mushroom mixture.
Pour the flour mixture into the skillet and stir constantly until the mixture thickens and forms a gooey texture.
Remove the skillet from the heat and stir in the soy sauce and sesame seeds.
To serve, place a portion of the rice mixture onto a talavera plate and top with pickled ginger slices.
